supported: HWP5/HWPX body and table-cell endnotes resolve through an exact owner path, anchor control, note kind, note instance ID and number. Rendered virtual paragraphs map to the note-local paragraph and character; trusted selection, caret placement, plain-text editing, Undo/Redo, T009 save and independent reopen preserve note identity, numbering and unrelated content. Unsupported or ambiguous addresses fail closed.
preservation: Endnote virtual addresses are resolved through the source owner's body/table-cell/textbox path; malformed paths, wrong note kinds, stale IDs/numbers and body-paragraph aliases are rejected without falling through to body editing.

The authentic HWP fixture has six endnotes: five body-owned and one owned by table cell 2. HWP and generated HWPX retain the same target section, anchor paragraph 11, control 0, note instance ID 32, number 3 and table owner path.

HWP T009 keeps all nine CFB streams and record topology. Decompressed DocInfo is byte-identical; the only BodyText/Section0 changes are the exact target PARA_HEADER and PARA_TEXT pair. For the table note, its endnote control number and nested list/header levels are independently proved; every other BodyText record is byte-identical.
HWPX T009 keeps all 12 OPC parts; only Contents/section0.xml changes for the note text. HWP/HWPX model inspection confirms all other endnote identities, numbers and text remain unchanged.
Undo restored the original rendered canvas state and Redo restored the edited canvas state. Same-session and fresh-process reopen resolved the same owner, ID, number, note text and rendered location.
RHWP source was rebuilt from the exact clean pin and 63 ordered patches. A fresh reconstruction matched all 1,654 prepared source files byte-for-byte. external/rhwp remained unchanged.
